content: BIBREF0 present four tasks in which systems have to automatically determine the intensity of emotions (EI) or the intensity of the sentiment (Valence) of tweets in the languages English, Arabic, and Spanish. The goal is to either predict a continuous regression (reg) value or to do ordinal classification (oc) based on a number of predefined categories. The EI tasks have separate training sets for four different emotions: anger, fear, joy and sadness. Due to the large number of subtasks and the fact that this language does not have many resources readily available, we only focus on the Spanish subtasks. Our work makes the following contributions:
